I read a few reviews who said it was sticky and although I believe that to be true when it's first applied, after about 20 min to an hour (I haven't exactly timed it), it dries down nicely. I mostly use it at night so when I wake up, my face is hydrated, smooth and bouncy! I also like to apply it in the morning when I first wake up, if my skin is feeling tight because my skin just drinks it up! It sits well under moisturizer and over my mists and essences, leaves my skin looking glowy and healthy, and once it dries down, it also sits well under makeup and blends in beautifully. I looooove that it's fragrance free too. That's so important to me because not only is my skin sensitive, I also suffer from chronic migraines and I have allergies and asthma, as well. This has virtually no smell. Per the instructions, you can use it like a mist, or if you prefer to use it like a more concentrated serum, simply hold the pump close against your face so it comes out in blobs. avis.texte: Sometimes I need a mask but just can’t handle the sensory overload I get with face masks. These sprays are an excellent substitute. I am a huge fan of face mists. I was worried about the mist being like a bad leave-in conditioner or setting sprays have been in the past. A direct stream, super soaker or clogged. The spray is even every time (and I waited before leaving this review to give them time to misbehave). I’m impressed! I wouldn’t use these as a part of skin preparation for makeup, though, as they can pill even when they’re the only thing on my skin. I personally haven’t noticed a difference between the Caviar and the Collagen (purple and pink, respectively). Sometimes I just spray a bit of each haphazardly. avis.titre: Ultra-Fine Mist That Actually Hydrates & Plumps Mature Skin
avis.texte: I’m 52, post-menopausal, with dry, sometimes sensitive skin, and I’m very particular about mists — most are either too wet, too fragranced, or just don’t do much. This one is different, and I’ve been really enjoying it. The first thing to know (and this makes a big difference): if you don’t hold it too close to your face, it creates a very fine, even mist. When sprayed from a bit of distance, it disperses beautifully and feels light and refreshing rather than leaving droplets sitting on the skin. The texture is slightly more substantial than a typical water mist — you can feel that there’s something in it. It gives immediate hydration and a soft, plumped look without feeling sticky or heavy. My skin looks fresher right after using it, which is exactly what I want from a mist. I use this in a few different ways: • As a first hydrating layer after cleansing • Between skincare steps for “skin flooding” • During the day to refresh and bring life back to my skin It layers extremely well and doesn’t disrupt anything underneath or on top. It actually helps everything feel more cohesive and comfortable. The collagen and peptides make this feel a bit more treatment-focused than your average mist. It’s not just refreshing — it feels like it’s actively supporting hydration and helping the skin look smoother and more supple over time. I also appreciate that it doesn’t leave any tackiness. avis.titre: Beautiful hydrating mist for normal skin; HA-loaded, not so effective for dry skin
avis.texte: BIODANCE Caviar PDRN Jelly Serum Mist is a Korean hydrating face mist. It comes in a cute plastic bottle with a spray-type dispenser, the bottle is nicely heavy, it’s pleasant to touch and to look at. Mist appears as a beautiful light-magenta jelly/hydrogel. The product features mainly caviar water and 5 types of hyaluronic acid (HA). It is good that caviar water is presented at the first place with 76% of the content and substitutes the water here. However, “caviar water” is a rather general term, the concentration and composition of active components in such steam distillates are not fixed or well regulated, so it might vary significantly between different manufacturers and actually be very low. The serum mist is applied via a spray-type dispenser, it does not appear as a mist cloud, more like small droplets that I need to tap for absorption. By definition, it immediately delivers some moisture to the skin, but the resulted performance largely depends on the skin type. If you have dry or dehydrated skin or live in dry air environment, then this product should not be used as a solo product. Similar to other HA-loaded mists/serums, the skin can feel even drier after the application than before, as HA might dehydrate the skin by pulling moisture from deeper layers of the skin rather than the air (with low moisture). I have combination skin and live in dry climate, some parts of the face feel sometimes dehydrated. When I use a skin hydration meter, it shows moisture level as 40

avis.titre: How do they get this to go from a gel to a spray?!
avis.texte: Whoever is designing these new Kbeauty products is definitely onto some sort of crazy physics defying stuff here. I am definitely not complaining, but it's definitely crazy to see. When you look inside the bottle, it looks literally solid, like a block of gel sitting in just a tiny bit of liquid to keep it moist. Aside from that, Biodance is already known for their amazing products, and this one is no different than the rest! The first ingredient on the ingredient list is Caviar Water, it also contains PDRN and caviar extract both for smoothing and nourishing your skin. I have been using this as a serum during my skin care routine. Since it contains all of the ingredients as their mask, I thought that the best way to utilize this would be for my skin to absorb as much of it as it can. If I sprayed this over all of my moisturizers and the rest of my makeup, I would worry that it would never fully absorb through all of those layers. This has felt wonderful on my skin and has definitely helped it 'glow' a bit more. I replaced my regular PDRN serum with this and it's been a really nice refreshing change. I feel like this is less heavy than my regular serum, but is also more effective and I am using far less product at once because of the spray. I have normal dehydrated skin that is sometimes sensitive to actives, but this hasn't caused me any irritation or issues at all. I also really like that there is no fragrance because that can also be irritating sometimes. When I apply this

avis.titre: Love that this serum is a spray, blends in easily and leaves skin smoother!
avis.texte: I am becoming a bigger and bigger fan of Korean skincare products, and this Biodance Collagen Peptides Jelly Serum Mist is yet another reason why. Because of the popularity of Korean skincare, I was pleasantly surprised by the $19 price which I think is very reasonable and an excellent value. Not only is it less expensive than other facial serums, the fact that it goes on as a mist means this bottle of serum is going to last longer than others that are the same size but use a dropper. I was shocked that what you can clearly see as a gel in the bottle actually sprays into a mist but that's exactly what it does. And the spray can be used one of two ways – Spray 8 inches away and it immediately absorbs on its own into the skin or spray close and apply to get a concentrated serum. The serum has a thin consistency (but not too watery), and it blends into the skin quickly and without any sticky or oily residue. It's difficult to see results quickly on my face but I used the serum for comparison on the back of my left hand. I'm in my late 50s so my skin is a bit wrinkled and thinner than it used to be. I have to say after only one application, my skin felt and visibly looked smoother vs. the hand with no serum. It's slight but it's there and that's just one application. (I've attached a photo – it's hard to see and I wish I could capture it better but the difference between left and right hands is there.) It's a glow that appears to come from a greater reflection of light (unlike ot

This jelly mist looks very solid in the bottle, but actually sprays like water. It looks like magic of sorts. The packaging is very attractive and looks good on the shelf, not just plain and practical. It does not smell of heavy perfume like another collagen spray I bought before, but has a light barely-there scent, if any at all. This is nice, because having anything this close to my nose, I rather it not bother or irritate me. The ingredient list is quite impressive, with many different peptides, adenosine, calcium, B3 (niacinamide), probiotics, B12 (cyanocobalamin), hyaluronic acid, collagen and more. It makes skin instantly glowy, dewy and moisturized. Skin appears to be more plump, softer and smoother, even after the first application. It does not feel heavy whatsoever. It can be used in several different ways, from my experience. The first and most obvious is directly spraying on the face, either before or after a moisturizer. The second way I have used it is spray a bit in my hand along with a moisturizer, rub my hands together and apply to the skin all at the same time. It seems to be effective either way. Good product at an affordable price, very happy with this purchase.
Obsessed with this serum mist! It feels lightweight but deeply hydrating, and it gives such a fresh, radiant finish. Perfect for dry or dull skin and works beautifully over makeup too.”

Love this mist! It’s become a nice addition to my skincare routine, especially when my skin needs a quick boost of hydration. The mist has a slightly thicker, jelly-serum feel compared to a typical face spray, so it feels more nourishing rather than just refreshing water. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin looking dewy without feeling sticky. One of the things I like most is how convenient it is. I can spray it on after cleansing as a lightweight serum step, or use it throughout the day to refresh my skin when it starts to feel dry. The fine mist distributes evenly and doesn’t leave large droplets on the face, which makes it easy to reapply over makeup as well. The formula includes caviar extract and PDRN, ingredients often used in Korean skincare to support hydration, elasticity, and overall skin vitality. PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide), derived from salmon DNA, is known for helping improve skin elasticity and hydration and has become a popular regenerative ingredient in K-beauty products. Caviar extract is rich in nutrients that help nourish the skin and contribute to a smoother, more radiant appearance. Another thing I appreciate is the travel-friendly size. The bottle is small enough to keep in a bag, so it’s easy to carry for trips or long days when my skin needs a quick refresh. Overall, this mist feels like a good balance between skincare and convenience. It hydrates, adds a subtle glow, and is easy to use throughout the day. If you enjoy lightweight Korean skincare

I have found Biodance to create high quality skincare products; although they don't always work for me, this is a good skincare company. When I saw this caviar PDRN jelly serum mist, I was excited to try it. Fortunately, this one works for me! I'm impressed by the ingredient list. I ran the ingredients through Beautypedia, and almost all of the ingredients rated very highly. The two or three that didn't rated average, with no ingredients in the "bad" or "worst" categories. I'm especially pleased that this mist is fragrance-free. I have mild rosacea, which is triggered by fragrance, and I also have some fragrance sensitivities (fragrance can give me headaches). It can be difficult to find skincare without fragrance, so I'm always happy to find things that are fragrance-free. The bottle is cute, portable, and easy to use; one pump of spray is all you really need for your face. I did find the mist to be a bit tacky, but it wasn't enough to turn off the product. I appreciate the hydration it delivers. I have used this both under and over makeup and didn't notice any difference in performance. Overall, I'm happy with this product.

I love this serum mist. It’s really different than sprays that I’ve tried that are more water based. It gives my skin a natural-looking, healthy glow and it coverage lasts a long time. I can feel it long after I spray it. I can spray it and leave it, or pat the mist lightly to spread it if my hands are clean. The spray is a fine mist. It takes 2-3 pumps for face and neck. It’s not as fine mist as an aerosol ones, but I much prefer this. This container of serum will last so much longer than aerosol cans, it’s more hydrating, and it lasts longer. I love to use this on days when I wear sunscreen and no makeup. Great to use after swimming when the pool chemicals can dry out my skin. The price is great for the quantity, the result, and lasting effect. Easy to carry in a purse, pool or beach bag, backpack, etc.

avis.titre: The Perfect "Daily" Version of My Favorite Mask
avis.texte: As a huge fan of Biodance, I’ve been obsessed with their viral overnight face masks for a while. The only downside? They can get pretty expensive if you use them every night. That’s why I was so excited to try this Hydrogel Spray Mask, and it did not disappoint! The "jelly-to-mist" texture is actually genius. It looks like a solid gel in the bottle, but it sprays out as a super fine mist that doesn't drip or feel watery. After just the first use, I noticed a huge difference in my skin texture—it felt smoother and had that bouncy, youthful glow I usually only get after a full facial. It really does feel like a moisture barrier that stays put all day. Between the collagen and the peptide complex, my skin looks way more plump and firm. If you want the deep hydration of their signature masks but in a more affordable, convenient daily format, this is definitely it!

This facial mist feels really refreshing and hydrating on the skin. The spray is very fine and light, so it applies evenly without leaving heavy droplets or making your face feel wet. It absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling soft and moisturized. The formula includes ingredients like PDRN and caviar extract, which are meant to help improve skin texture and give the skin a healthier glow. After using it, my skin looks a little more refreshed and less dull. It’s nice to use in the morning, after skincare, or even throughout the day when your skin needs a quick boost. I also like how versatile it is. It works well as a hydrating mist, a light toner step, or even as a setting spray over makeup to add a bit of glow. It’s a simple product, but it’s a nice addition to a routine if you like lightweight skincare that helps keep your skin looking hydrated and radiant.

avis.titre: Unique Jelly-to-Mist Serum That Leaves Skin Hydrated and Glowing
avis.texte: This is the Biodance Caviar PDRN Jelly Serum Mist, and it really is exactly what it says—a jelly that transforms into a mist when sprayed. It’s a very unique texture and application. It looks like a gel in the bottle bust sprays out as a mist! This mist is extremely hydrating. My skin immediately felt plumper and more refreshed after using it. I also tried spraying it on my hands, and it actually worked better than lotion to quickly rehydrate them. The formula is made with 76% steam-distilled caviar water, which contains omega-3 to help nourish the skin and give it a healthy glow. It also includes high-purity salmon DNA (PDRN), which is often used in Korean skincare to support skin repair and hydration. I’ve been a fan of Biodance products for quite a while. I visited South Korea a few years ago and had some skincare treatments done there. The plastic surgeon I visited gave me several Biodance masks before they became widely popular, and I’ve liked the brand ever since. This product works quickly and absorbs fast while still leaving the skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. The bottle is small enough to carry in a bag, but it also works well as part of a daily skincare routine—just spray it on after washing your face. If you want a quick refresh, hold the bottle about 8–10 inches away from your face. If you want to use it more like a serum, you can spray it closer to the skin. Overall, this is a really interesting and effective hydrating mist that leaves skin looking fresh and

My wife really likes Korean skincare products, especially collagen treatments, so she was excited to try this Biodance Collagen Peptide Jelly Serum Mist. The packaging looks high quality and the bottle has a nice spray applicator that makes it easy to apply after cleansing. The serum itself is a thicker, slightly viscous jelly that turns into a fine mist when sprayed. It spreads easily and feels hydrating on the skin. The formula is based on collagen water with added peptides and other skincare ingredients that are meant to help with hydration and give the skin a healthy glow. She also likes the moisturizing feel and the scent, which is light and pleasant without being overpowering. The bottle is 50 ml which is a good size for a serum mist. Overall it seems like a well made Korean skincare product and so far she is happy with it.

avis.titre: Gentle, unscented (I think) serum that absorbs very quickly
avis.texte: This spray serum is very easy to use -- simply give it a good shake, close your eyes & roll in your lips, and spray. I've personally found that I usually need about 4 spritzes, one for each quadrant of my face. As far as I can tell, there's no sort of scent or fragrance to this serum mist, which I really like since strong smells close to my nose are sometimes bothersome. The sprayer works well at dispensing this serum very finely and evenly. My skin is obviously quite shiny and moist right after spraying this serum, as expected, but it doesn't stay looking super shiny for very long. In my attached photo collage, that's my cheek right after spraying and then again about a minute later. As you can see, it starts to dry and absorb fairly quickly. I've been able to finish off the rest of my skincare routine without any issues and I've not had any irritation or breakout problems either since adding this serum into my regime.

Biodance is either a hit or miss with me. This one is an absolute hit! Love the packaging. You get a ton of product for a hydrating serum with this one. The spray is very controlled. The photo shows 1 spray on my hand. A little goes a long way! That one spray covered the front & back of my hand. Very light jelly consistency. Easy to blend out and dries semi-matte. I felt an instant hydration increase. This serum is definitely worth it! Travel friendly, reliable results (in the short term at least), goes great under makeup. Obviously this one will need a review update as far as long term results after I've had some time to consistently use it. For now, this one is a winner! 100% recommend this serum.

I love the texture of this lightweight facial mist. It has a gel like consistency but it sprays out of the bottle in a fine mist. The formula contains low molecular collagen and a peptide complex to deeply hydrate, plump, and firm the skin. Being able to just spray this on my face and let it absorb is much quicker than applying a mask and this gel mist gives similar results to the Biodance Collagen Hydrogel sheet masks, but without the extra down time. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin feeling protected but not sticky or tacky. It works well with the rest of my skin care products and my skin looks plump and glowy after using this mist.
It looks nice, but it seems prone to leaking if you intend to use it as a travel format.
10/10 se lo e recomendado a TODAS mis amigas … me encanta …. Ya mi cara no se ve reseca luego de maquillarme

I had never used a spray serum before, so I decided to try this one after seeing so many good reviews. I bought it during Amazon's sale days, and I'm glad I did. It feels very fresh and pleasant on the skin. I use it after cleansing my face before going to bed, and after a few weeks of using it, I can say that I really like it.

avis.titre: Hydrating Glow in a Convenient Face Mist
avis.texte: Jelly Serum Mist! This face mist is lightweight, refreshing, and gives my skin an instant boost of hydration. The spray feels comfortable on the skin and leaves my face looking more radiant and healthy without feeling sticky or heavy.

I’ve been using the Biodance Collagen Peptide Jelly Serum Mist for a while now, and I really like it. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and gives my skin an instant boost of hydration without feeling sticky. My skin looks smoother, more refreshed, and has a healthy glow after each use. I also love that it works well under makeup and can be used throughout the day for extra hydration. Overall, it’s a great addition to my skincare routine, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a hydrating, refreshing serum mist.

avis.titre: Refreshing Mist That Leaves Skin Soft & Hydrated
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this collagen serum mist. The spray is fine and even, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling hydrated without any sticky residue. It gives my complexion a healthy, dewy look and works well both before and after makeup. The packaging is also very pretty. Overall, a refreshing and convenient addition to my skincare routine

I love it!! I hope they produce big bottles of these. This is my favorite wear everyday since i started using it. I use it at day time and i use the purple pdrn at night. Both works really great on my skin face. Leaves my face moist, glassy and smooth looking.

I really like the concept of this product. As my skin has been aging, I’ve been exploring different Korean skincare options focused on improving elasticity, supporting collagen production, and protecting my skin barrier, especially since I have sensitive skin. This mist feels very hydrating when applied, and the spray itself is impressively fine and even. I usually hold it a short distance from my face, and it distributes nicely without feeling heavy or overwhelming. I was initially worried it might be sticky, but it’s not at all, it actually feels more like a refreshing water mist than I expected. So far, I haven’t experienced any irritation, which is a big plus for me. My only downside is the size of the bottle. It’s quite small, and I notice it going down quickly with each use. Since I only use it once at night, I don’t see it lasting more than a few weeks. I do wish it came in a larger size so I could test it longer. Overall, a gentle, hydrating mist that works well for sensitive skin, but I’d love better value in terms of product size.
